preconditions.description: The dimensions of the field are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: len(rows) == n and all(0 <= ai <= m for ai in rows)
preconditions.description: The number of contiguous black segments in each row is valid.

preconditions.expression: len(columns) == m and all(0 <= bi <= n for bi in columns)
preconditions.description: The number of contiguous black segments in each column is valid.

postconditions.expression: len(output) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in output)
postconditions.description: The output consists of n lines each containing m characters.

postconditions.expression: all(cell in ['.', '*'] for row in output for cell in row)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output is either '.' (white) or '*' (black).

postconditions.expression: all(count_black_segments(row) == ai for ai, row in zip(rows, output))
postconditions.description: Each row has the correct number of contiguous black segments.

postconditions.expression: all(count_black_segments(column) == bi for bi, column in zip(columns, zip(*output)))
postconditions.description: Each column has the correct number of contiguous black segments.
